conversationalSummary.text: TODAY looks like there’s no reliable window, so I’d probably save the drive. Almagreira is the best option around lunch, but wind looks like the main headache and Surfline consistency is pretty poor, so it could turn choppy fast. I’d check Surfline and MEO Beachcam before committing—unless the cams look noticeably cleaner than expected, I’d skip.

best.explanation: Almagreira looks like a small north coast window for Rare window, Low confidence: 0.3-0.6 m, 16 kJ, 3 s period, lully 0/100, and wind is the main risk.  An exposed north-coast beach break with more raw swell than Baleal; this is best for small, clean north-coast days when protected spots look underpowered; 6-9s at mid tide can make exposed beaches like Belgas / Almagreira / Cerro / Meio da Baia sharp and rippable, so checking exposed beaches makes sense.  Watch: Surfline consistency is lully; wind angle is poor for this spot.
best.shortExplanation: Almagreira is worth a quick check for lunch, but it is not a guaranteed session.  Treat it as a check-first call rather than a sure thing.  Wind is the main thing to watch.  The tide and timing are lining up well for this spot.
warnings: wind angle is poor for this spot
